Anne Marie d'Orléans.subject: Women & Society
Anne Marie d'Orléans.question: When the war was ended in 1713 by the Treaty of Utrecht, _____ received the Kingdom of Sicily, formerly a Spanish possession
Anne Marie d'Orléans.fact: Despite his marriage ties to France, Victor Amadeus joined the anti-French side in the War of the Spanish Succession. In 1706, Turin was besieged by French forces under the command of Anne Marie's half-brother Philippe d'Orléans, and Spanish forces of her cousin and son-in-law Philip V. She and her sons Victor Amadeus and Carlo Emanuele were forced to flee to Genoa.

Anne Marie d'Orléans.subject: Women & Society
Anne Marie d'Orléans.question: In 1720, _____ retained his title of King but was forced to exchange Sicily for the less important duchy of Sardinia
Anne Marie d'Orléans.fact: When Victor Amadeus left for his coronation in Sicily, he had originally planned to leave Anne Marie behind to function as regent in his absence, but as he feared that she would let herself be directed by his mother due to her loyalty to her mother-in-law, he changed his mind and took her along with him instead. At the death of her eldest son in 1715, both she and Victor Amadeus fell into severe depression and left the capital to mourn, leaving Marie Jeanne to handle their official duties.
